learningObjectives: Explain class hierarchy structure in a scenario.
Explain modular architecture and enterprise reuse in a scenario.
Explain new Pega platform applications in a scenario.

elements.description: Place assets at their reuse scope: enterprise-wide → Organization; regional or brand-wide → optional Division; unit-wide → optional Unit (requires Division); a specific business application → Implementation. Platform supplies the foundation. Constellation starts with the Data Model and generates a prescribed experience; its design system, architecture, DX API and business engine have distinct roles.

elements.text: Worked example: Shared address lookup belongs to a reusable scope; a single-brand returns policy belongs to that brand. Decide who consumes an asset before choosing its layer.

elements.description: Keep Enterprise lean. Put reusable customer data, single-system integration and utility capabilities in modules; place workflow-specific Cases in business applications. Specialize geographic or segment differences in innovation applications. Reuse modules through built-on applications or the wizard. Prefer parameters, extension points and Configuration Sets to copies; shared changes affect consumers.

elements.text: Worked example: A document conversion service can be one utility module consumed by Claims and Lending. Put workflow-specific decisions in the consuming business application.

elements.description: Blueprint captures a collaborative application design: Case Types, lifecycle, data and Personas. App Studio’s New Application wizard turns an existing or newly created Blueprint into an initial application. Treat generated design as a starting point to review against requirements. Reusable designs speed repeated application creation.

elements.text: Worked example: A team agrees a Warranty Blueprint, reviews its Case lifecycle and data, then uses the wizard to create the application. A design import still needs implementation and validation.

elements.text: Try the quiz before rereading. Explain why each distractor fails. Use Smart Review on later days; revisit answers you got wrong with high confidence.

examPitfalls.title: Reuse scope
examPitfalls.trapDescription: A brand policy must be copied into every application.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Choose the narrowest layer that covers all intended consumers.

examPitfalls.title: Shared changes
examPitfalls.trapDescription: A module change cannot affect consumers.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Assess shared consumers when changing a reused capability.

examPitfalls.title: Blueprint vs deployment
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Importing a design completes production deployment.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Review and implement the generated application, then validate and deploy it.

quickRecap.value: Organization → enterprise; Division → brand/region; Unit requires Division; Implementation → specific application.
Shared capability in a module; workflow in business app; situational variation in innovation app.
Design first; review generated Cases, data and Personas; create through the New Application wizard.
